🔥 OFFICIAL REVIEWER PROGRAM

Many shoppers don’t realize that SHEIN offers an official product testing program where selected users may receive products to evaluate before sharing honest feedback about their experience.

Participants who are chosen can test clothing, shoes, accessories, and other products while providing detailed reviews about sizing, quality, comfort, materials, and overall satisfaction.

Selection is based on SHEIN’s own criteria and is never guaranteed. Available products, eligibility requirements, and participation rules may vary depending on your account and the opportunities currently offered.

🔥 THE MOST IMPORTANT STEP BEFORE APPLYING

Keep your SHEIN profile complete and updated. Make sure your size information, shipping address, and previous purchase history are accurate. Whenever possible, leave honest reviews for products you’ve already purchased.

Applications should always be submitted through the official SHEIN website or mobile app. Never pay third parties promising guaranteed approval or priority access.

How the Official SHEIN Reviewer Program Works

Visit the SHEIN Product Testing section to browse the items currently available for review. Choose a product that matches your measurements and submit your application.

If your application is selected, you’ll receive the product, test it under normal use, and submit a detailed review before the deadline shown in your account.

Material: evaluate softness, thickness, stretch, transparency, and fabric quality.

Construction: inspect stitching, finishing, zippers, buttons, and overall craftsmanship.

Fit: compare the actual fit with the published size chart and explain any differences.

Daily Wear: describe comfort, movement, styling possibilities, and overall experience after wearing the item.
